mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over the prior 3 months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales over the prior 2 months indicate broad consumer demand weakness, signaling reduced corporate revenue growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 2 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, industrial production above 105.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing peak, preceding corporate profit slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO > 105.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 1.5% per annum signals monetary tightening, increasing cost of capital and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP (GDPC1) over the prior 6 months indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 grows over 6 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment growth and rise in unemployment over the prior 2 months indicates labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decline > 0.5% and UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS declines > 0.5% and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 2 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate above 1.5% per annum signals aggressive policy, increasing borrowing costs and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over 3 years.
